newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel steady, inactive on lack of vessels.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel steady, inactive on lack of vessels.

text.p: NWE jet fuel premiums were discussed little changed on Thursday, with volume blocked by lack of shipping from the Mediterranean, traders said.
Feb IPE gas oil futures closed $5.25 up at $219 a tonne on forecasts of colder weather in the northeastern United States.
NWE barges look balanced, with more demand seen emerging in early February. Barges were notionally around Feb +$30/31 fob ARA. Cif cargoes NWE were around Feb IPE +$33/34.
In the Med, non-EU material is around fob Med high +$2/4, with Algerian at +$4/6.
